gaps: Maavehi returned no published map records at retrieval. Coverage is unresolved; this does not establish roads are open or unobstructed.
Weather alert polygons are advisory exposure areas; no observed road speed, flooding, ferry cancellation or demand inference.
No public historical road-speed training dataset verified. Congestion controls must be labeled scenario stress tests.
Outer-island map is population/evidence readiness only. Unmatched locations remain unplotted; no nationwide routing is fabricated.
Satellite imagery is display/context evidence. No unverified building-growth, congestion or obstruction measurements are generated.

ai.reason: Deterministic extraction is available without a key; optional server-side AI requires explicit configuration.

limitations: These columns are departures in opposite directions, not departure/arrival pairs. No crossing time is published.
No dated cancellation or public-holiday exception calendar verified.
Saturday timetable explicitly leaves 17:20–17:30 unspecified; no frequency is interpolated across that gap.
